install_tell: bash run.sh up [--guardrails-file=path] -> docker network invariant-explorer-web + gateway/docker-compose.local.yml; container invariant-gateway, uvicorn serve:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000, host-mapped 8005:8000. Prints 'Gateway started at http://localhost:8005/api/v1/gateway/'.
misconfig_patterns: Self-hosted gateway bound 0.0.0.0 on 8005 with no front-end auth. INVARIANT_API_KEY is required ONLY when GUARDRAILS_FILE_PATH is set (run.sh enforces the pairing) -- run without a guardrails file and the port has NO auth gate at all, a pure pass-through OpenAI/Anthropic/Gemini/MCP proxy still capturing every trace.
GUARDRAILS_FILE_PATH unset -> guardrails disabled; gateway forwards all traffic and logs prompts/responses/tool-calls with zero policy enforcement.

Operator provider creds (OPENAI_API_KEY / ANTHROPIC_API_KEY / GEMINI_API_KEY) injected as container env; readable via docker inspect if the Docker API/socket is exposed. The gateway strips invariant-authorization + host + x-forwarded-* before forwarding upstream (IGNORED_HEADERS), so provider keys ride the operator env, not the client request.
MCP proxy mode (/api/v1/gateway/mcp/sse, streamable) forwards tool-call payloads -- direct relevance to the same org's mcp-injection-experiments tool-poisoning research.
DEV_MODE=true (docker-compose.local.yml default) runs uvicorn --reload with source bind-mounts -- dev posture shipped as the quickstart default.

active_probe.false_positive_check: Conjunctive marker-anchored: body must be JSON containing the exact literal {"message":"Hello from Invariant v1/gateway"} (source-fixed string in gateway/serve.py check_health, include_in_schema=False -- structural build witness, not a spoofable title). Corroborate with build-artifact anchor GET /api/v1/gateway/openapi.json containing route templates '/api/v1/gateway/{dataset}/openai' + '/api/v1/gateway/{dataset}/anthropic'. Reject SPA/reverse-proxy catch-all HTML. Secondary anchor: GET / returns 307 redirect Location: https://explorer.invariantlabs.ai/docs/gateway.

deployment_tells: Port 8005 (host) -> 8000 (container uvicorn); GET /api/v1/gateway/health returns {"message":"Hello from Invariant v1/gateway"}

FastAPI custom-mounted docs: /api/v1/gateway/docs (Swagger), /api/v1/gateway/redoc, /api/v1/gateway/openapi.json -- standard FastAPI paths relocated under the gateway prefix (distinctive build artifact)
Container name invariant-gateway on docker network invariant-explorer-web; optional Traefik front-end routing PathPrefix(/api/v1/gateway/)
pivot_paths: GET /api/v1/gateway/health -- unauth liveness + identity confirm (no key required)
GET /api/v1/gateway/openapi.json -- full route inventory incl. per-provider + MCP endpoints and dataset path params
GET /api/v1/gateway/docs -- interactive Swagger UI, no auth on the proxy port by default
POST /api/v1/gateway/{dataset}/openai (or /anthropic /gemini) -- if no guardrails file + no key gate, an open LLM proxy billing the operator's provider key
GET / -- 307 to explorer.invariantlabs.ai/docs/gateway confirms the platform even behind a renamed port
vulnerabilities: No CVEs published as of 2026-07-04. NVD keyword 'invariantlabs' = 0; GitHub Security Advisories on invariant-gateway/invariant = 0. Threat-research-led org (publishes attacks: mcp-injection-experiments MCP tool poisoning); no disclosed bugs in own infra.

Design-level exposure (not a CVE): gateway port ships auth-off unless GUARDRAILS_FILE_PATH forces INVARIANT_API_KEY; self-hosted quickstart default is an unauthenticated trace-capturing LLM/MCP proxy.
tagline: LLM proxy to observe and debug what your AI agents are doing
dork_population_substitution_risk: MEDIUM-HIGH. Two populations: (a) SaaS users routing via explorer.invariantlabs.ai (Shodan-dark; only cert pivot reveals them), and (b) self-hosted operators on port 8005. The port:8005 dork selects (b) only, a small fraction skewed toward stricter data-residency orgs. Conclusions about (b) do not generalize to (a).
